scope: Sony ILCE-6000 fw 3.21; static-only. No camera connection, flashing, firmware execution, package installation, or modification of original binaries.

findings.claim: The PbCap path allocates a new raster DMM unit plus an SDS DMM unit, processes them through SDF resize/rotate or the super-resolution alternative, and only then emits PlayData.
The SDS accessor maps a 0x800-byte physical SDS block and obtains ImageSizeInfo, YcStateInfo, and ImageOutTimInfo; RightImageSizeInfo and DisplayInfo are optional entries.
findings.limit: Symbol names prove exposed ABI fields, not their serialized offsets or values in this PbCap SDS.

findings.claim: The PlayData builder sends separate raster and SDS descriptors, copies unaligned geometry to 0x1019/0x101a, aligns the raster canvas to 64x16, and forwards only SDS colorimetry and Y range to 0x1072/0x1073.
ObjStillRecorder computes input extent totals and passes RegionInfo to MprIf; FeaIf copies RegionInfo into an asynchronous message and returns without waiting for encoding completion.
The released mach-cxd90014 CMPR driver is a physical-buffer LZPART compressor with DMA synchronization, not a JPEG or YC driver.
CMPR, PL310 cache configuration, or OSS DMA code are used by SDF, ObjCamera, FEA, or this YC pipeline.
findings.reason: No static call, dependency, or shared proprietary DMM/SDS implementation links the kernel driver to libObj.so or libmpr.so.

findings.claim: The real raster YC component order, plane count, planar/interleaved layout, subsampling, pitch/stride, and plane offsets.
findings.reason: Neither RegionInfo nor the recovered PbCap builder supplies these values; SDS field names do not establish their contents.

findings.claim: A native ObjCamera/Live View YC descriptor is compatible with the PbCap raster+SDS pair or reaches Sequence 0x6013.
findings.reason: The recovered end-to-end producer is PbCap/Player through ObjEffect; no Camera descriptor chain to SDF/EncodeStill was recovered.

findings.claim: The generic CMPR driver identifies the YC format or implements the JPEG/ISP stage of the recovered pipeline.
findings.reason: The driver implements LZPART compression and lacks a demonstrated static edge to the proprietary pipeline.

conclusion.claim: PbCap has a verified SDF-produced raster+SDS handoff before the asynchronous FEA encode submission. This strengthens the requirement for an SDS metadata block but does not establish a pixel format or any Live View path.

safety_conclusion.claim: SilentShutter functionality is not demonstrated by this analysis.
